===Research===

1) He is either level 24 or 25, and an undercon, hitting for 60-80dmg.

2) He spawns instantly after Kurrpock is killed, at the entrance to the underwater chamber, near the water line, blocking the exit. The below map has his correct spawn location ("necro/enchanter spawns here"):

http://wiki.project1999.com/File:Infected_Paw_MapB.jpg

2.5) After he spawns, he says to give him the gem: "Give me the eye of Kurrpok!" and waits for a moment before attacking. After some time he should path up the dungeon to the entrance, slaughtering newbies. He probably camped the zone in. Unknown if he despawned after some time or if you had to kill him.

https://www.project1999.com/forums/showpost.php?p=3029826&postcount=54

3) He gave the following faction hits if killed:

  Ring of Scale -  
  League of Antonican Bards +
  Trakanon +
  Mayong Mistmoore +
  Carson McCabe +
  
https://github.com/dbsanfte/eq-archives/blob/master/screenshots/classic_paw/uoimySv.png

4) If you hand him the gem you get from Kurrpok, he should give you opposite faction hits from killing him, and a bit of xp. He instantly despawns.

5) He starts out life as a Necromancer until late July 1999, then changes into a Wizard.

6) Occasionally drops high value gems (sapphire and star ruby were both mentioned, maybe others?) This page says he also dropped a fire emerald and emerald, so seems to have a loot table of various gems of that tier: https://web.archive.org/web/boards.stratics.com/20001016142853/forums/Forum64/HTML/000197.html

According to another reference I found, he can also drop a "70pp bracelet" (probably just a cash drop) and gossamer robe, rarely:

  Posted By: Tallismon Treehugor of Prexus on Nov. 13, 1999 at 1:45pm EST
  Killing the High Shaman Kurrpock will also force the spawn on the Darkelf. The Darkelf spawns right outside of the room with Kurrpock by the 
  underwater tunnel. BE WARNED HE IS LVL 23 TO 26! and killed me when I was lvl 27. He drops some kind of braclet worth 70pp to the merchants 
  and a Gossimor Robe both are rare drops.

https://web.archive.org/web/20001216030800/www.eqmaps.com/zone.php3?tag=paw&pg=3

Dropped 4g 11s cash on the screenshotted kill we have:

https://github.com/dbsanfte/eq-archives/blob/master/screenshots/classic_paw/uoimySv.png

7) On killing someone he said "The Circle will be most pleased."

https://www.project1999.com/forums/showpost.php?p=3092668&postcount=79

8) On death he would say "Argh!!  The dragons shall hear of your treachery!"

https://github.com/dbsanfte/eq-archives/blob/master/screenshots/classic_paw/uoimySv.png

https://www.project1999.com/forums/showpost.php?p=3029826&postcount=54

===Possible Quest Text and Experience for Turnin===

I played a bard of Veeshan in a past life before, back before the lair of the Splitpaw had been taken over by the Tesch Mal.

Kurrpok Splitpaw, the boss of the dungeon, had a ruby eye (part of the ruby skull quest). As soon as Kurrpok died, a dark elf named Zixx Nenixx (or something like that) would appear outside Kurrpok's lair, and go on a killing spree, and quite literally kill every single PC and NPC in the dungeon, and then run out into South Karana.

And that's where things get interesting. I was down there with some friends (with my bard of Veeshan), and when Zixx spawned, he actually did a /cheer emote at me (I kid you not). I hailed him (he looked upon me warmly) and he said that if we wanted to live we should turn over the [eye]. I said "What eye?" and he said something to the effect of "Don't play stupid with me" and attacked us and went about the usual.

So anyways, the next time he appeared, I just went up and handed him the ruby. He thanked me for servitude to the ring and spouted off something or other about world domination, and I got half and orange bubble of XP (while grouped with 4 other people, we all got it), and a positive faction hit with ring of scale.

Anyways, just thought I'd mention that. Prior to the release of Kunark he was the only NPC I ever met that was on the Ring of Scale faction.

And by the way, here's another interesting Veeshan oriented tidbit... everquest.allakhazam.com/...?quest=457

I of course scoured Qeynos, but was unsuccessful finding any scale followers, but it could certainly justify a cult as the original poster was talking about.

- Syll Hateborn
Warchanter of Rallos Zek

  Zixx Nenix is a 25 dark elf wizard. in the OLD splitpaw dungeon, he would instaspawn the moment Kurrpok Splitpaw was killed (kurrpok himself had a placeholder too, killing the placeholder didnt spawn zixx). Anyway i used to hang 
  out in the old paw to look for clues on the gnoll slayer quest, and once i hit 32 and figured out the whole spawn setup, i started soloing zixx nenix for exp and loot. then i saw the faction (im at work so this is out of memory): 
  faction goes up with:
  
  MayongMistmoore
  Trakanon
  LeagueOfAntonicanBards
  CarsonMcCabe
  goes down with Ring of Scale.. thats it.
  
  yes you read that right, and no i didn't make some mistake. BOTH bards & mistmoore go UP.
  
  unfortunately, Paw is now a high level dungeon, and although kurrpok still spawns, he still spawns in the deepest part of the dungeon. not only that, but the new gnolls KOS him when he spawns. therefore the only way to try and 
  use this would be to get a couple good groups in the deep cave in paw (about 12 spawns in there) and keep it clear.. supposedly if you kill kurrpok zixx still pops in the same place he used to. dunno if they changed his faction, 
  but i doubt it.
